The modifications across the files are interconnected, primarily focusing on the handling of the `cred` attribute in the Oozie workflow actions. Overall, the modifications ensure that the cred tag is consistently required across all actions, improving the robustness of the workflow execution and preventing potential errors related to credential handling.
